# truenas_snapshot_rollback (Action)

Rolls a dataset back to one of its snapshots (pool.snapshot.rollback). Destroys any data written after the snapshot.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `snapshot` (String) Snapshot name to roll back to, e.g. "tank/data@snap1".

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Force unmount of any file systems that need to be unmounted.
- `recursive` (Boolean) Destroy any snapshots and bookmarks more recent than the one specified.
- `recursive_clones` (Boolean) Like recursive, but also destroy any clones of those snapshots.
- `recursive_rollback` (Boolean) Roll back the given snapshot and all intermediate snapshots on all descendant datasets.
